name: local-autocomplete
description: Tab autocomplete in VS Code backed by a local llama.cpp server (FIM). No cloud, no telemetry.

localAutocomplete.enabled.description: Show inline completions from the local model.

localAutocomplete.endpoint.description: Base URL of llama-server. The extension sends requests only here.

localAutocomplete.disabledLanguages.description: Language IDs where completions are turned off.

localAutocomplete.debounceMs.description: Pause in typing (ms) before a request is sent.

localAutocomplete.prefixLines.description: Lines before the cursor sent as context.

localAutocomplete.suffixLines.description: Lines after the cursor sent as context.

localAutocomplete.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (n_predict).

localAutocomplete.maxPredictMs.description: Generation time limit (ms); the server stops at the next new line once it is exceeded (t_max_predict_ms).

localAutocomplete.maxLineSuffix.description: Skip automatic completion when more than this many non-space characters follow the cursor on the line.

localAutocomplete.timeoutMs.description: Abort a request that takes longer than this (ms).
